request: Stage Receiver candidate without disturbing current production Receiver; capture early exit error and cleanup only staging container.

bounded_host_request.command: set -e; name=gace-receiver-test-20261013; old=server-core-bounded-host; ! docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --name "$name" --network gace-internal --user 1000:1000 --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:size=32m,mode=1777 --security-opt no-new-privileges --cap-drop ALL --pids-limit 64 --memory 192m --volumes-from "$old":ro --env-file <(docker inspect -f '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' "$old") gace-server-core-bounded-host:hostsha-d7f7d390 >/dev/null; sleep 2; docker inspect -f 'STAGING_RUNNING={{.State.Running}} EXIT={{.State.ExitCode}}' "$name"; docker logs --tail 12 "$name" 2>&1 | sed -E 's/(secret|token|password)=([^ ]+)/\1=[REDACTED]/Ig' | cut -c1-120; docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null
